roles.title: Branding & Visual Communications Specialist
alt_titles: Program Specialist II - Branding and Visual Communications (official classification, from the Hemet application)

bullets.text: Co-facilitated grant writing for the ACCESS Indian Canyon project, which earned a $50 million LTCAP grant.
Introduced SharePoint collaboration to grant writing, replacing the practice of piecing together dated content from earlier applications that each had a different structure and audience.

Introduced AI into the grant production workflow for the RAISE grant by demonstrating it in production meetings. It restructured content quickly, saved days of proofreading by checking the application against the RFP, and surfaced connections the team had missed.
When the RAISE grant was changed to the BUILD grant with a new RFP and the same deadline, used the new workflow to retarget the application promptly.
Advocated for a centralized, maintained repository of ACCESS Indian Canyon content so accurate, appropriately structured grant applications can be produced without patchwork.
Designed multi-agency grant deliverables integrating policy text, visuals, and compliance documentation in a unified format.
Created visual narratives to support major grant applications, regional initiatives, and budget communications.
Designed and developed an in-house pairwise comparison survey web app to engage stakeholders and prioritize regional transportation projects, saving CVAG $9,500.
Designed and developed an in-house pairwise comparison survey web app to engage stakeholders and prioritize regional transportation projects, saving the agency over $9,000.
Coded a pairwise comparison survey used to shape five years of transportation investment priorities across the Coachella Valley.

Built the survey app from scratch with custom logic and a tailored interface for the Executive Director to use on a touchscreen in front of stakeholders. It was a first-of-its-kind internal tool for CVAG.
Translated survey data into visual reports and storytelling for stakeholders using PowerPoint, Excel, and Adobe InDesign.

Built an in-house typography and template system using Microsoft cloud fonts, chosen for platform compatibility, to future-proof agency materials for digital and print use. It produced the 2024/25 CVAG and CVCC annual budget books.
Created a dual-format publishing workflow: complex publications designed in InDesign while staff maintain design integrity in Word for collaboration. SharePoint links render correctly across devices.
Optimized the workflow for CVAG's budget books using InDesign, Word, and PDF export automation, for both print and digital.
Designed and developed annual reports, budget books, grant applications, public presentations, event collateral, and fact sheets for four regional agencies.

Designed and produced public-facing marketing and communication materials including brochures, fact sheets, newsletters, event signage, annual reports, budget books, and executive presentations for four regional agencies.
Designed and produced over 200 branded PowerPoint presentations for public board and committee meetings.
Designed and produced hundreds of executive-level and pitch-style presentations, including pitch decks, partnership proposals, annual reports, budget books, and executive briefings.
Transformed content-heavy outlines, written briefs, and data-driven materials into visual presentation narratives supporting strategic, funding, and stakeholder objectives.
Built and maintained scalable presentation systems, including PowerPoint master slide templates, branded layouts, and standardized workflows for consistency and rapid turnaround.
Developed custom charts, infographics, maps, illustrations, iconography, and visual systems to communicate complex financial, transportation, and policy data.
Managed multiple concurrent design projects in a deadline-driven environment, frequently delivering same-day or short-notice executive presentations.

Founded and scaled the presentation design, branding, and visual communications function for a newly created role, establishing systems, workflows, and standards, and serving as primary designer for executive leadership and cross-departmental stakeholders.
Developed and enforced brand style guidelines and standardized templates to maintain a consistent visual identity across print, digital, and presentation channels for multiple agencies.
Centralized reusable digital assets into quality-controlled SharePoint libraries and built a knowledge base and document libraries for asset management and Office template deployment.
Administered Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, using the platform's existing capabilities to avoid unnecessary software purchases.
Built a custom SharePoint slide-deck production tracker to manage workflow with staff report authors, replacing lengthy email chains and drop-ins.
Directed A/V production and managed all content for over 200 public meetings livestreamed to the community, posting agendas and supporting materials to agency websites.

After a power surge disabled the equipment used to conduct meetings in the Parkview conference room, reverse-engineered the system topology, identified the breaks, and built a mobile A/V system that outperforms the built-in system for less than $900.
Ran A/V for over 200 elected committee and special presentations using PowerPoint, Teams, and custom hybrid meeting setups.
Independently managed and developed the CVAG and CVCC websites in WordPress, ensuring ADA accessibility compliance and accuracy of public-facing information.
Directed web contractors on improving usability, mobile responsiveness, and document access for community members and stakeholders.
Published agendas, newsletters, committee packets, and public announcements in compliance with Brown Act requirements.
Shot most of the photography for agency publications including budget books and annual reports, coordinating content across department heads and executive leadership through multiple review cycles.
Led design and production for the annual General Assembly gala, including multimedia content, a bespoke printed booklet, email registration campaigns, sponsor materials, and event signage.

Collaborated with the clerk to design, schedule, and send an annual Constant Contact email campaign promoting the General Assembly gala and driving registration among elected officials and contractors. The campaign linked to a landing page that processed payments and collected dinner orders.
Created a public-facing landing page and fact sheet to manage media inquiries following Tropical Storm Hilary, developing the messaging and design under a same-day deadline.
Monitored, updated, and responded as needed on CVAG's social media accounts, and produced graphics, photography, and event materials for agency social channels.
Collaborated with executive leadership to develop clear, community-focused messaging for programs in transportation, sustainability, and regional planning.
Prepared draft reports, memoranda, talking points, fact sheets, and presentation materials for management review.

Translated technical and scientific content on transportation, sustainability, and environmental planning into clear, public-facing language for elected officials and community audiences, including in grant applications for infrastructure projects.
Coordinated communications and presentation strategy across multiple agencies housed under CVAG, including DCE and CVCC, and served as liaison for internal branding needs.
Guided colleagues one-on-one on branding, presentation strategy, and communication best practices.
Implemented structured, transparent performance planning systems to align duties and deliverables across departments.

roles.title: Art Director
alt_titles: Creative Technology Director (from the Hemet application)

bullets.text: Grew a two-person collaboration into a ten-person full-service branding, marketing, and web development agency.
Recruited, mentored, and directed local designers and web developers, supervising two designers and two developers and providing feedback, quality control, and support for professional growth.
Managed the creative process from concept to completion, delegating tasks and managing timelines so projects met deadlines and budgets.
Researched, designed, and implemented tech stacks for the agency and its clients, and evaluated and recommended hardware and software.

Administered account licensing, permissions, and troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 and Adobe Creative Cloud, for the agency and on behalf of clients, and maintained equipment inventory and asset tracking.
Led multichannel marketing campaigns for nonprofit and community-facing clients, managing strategy, design, and production across social media, email, paid advertising, and print.

Managed client social media accounts on Facebook and Instagram, developing content calendars, writing post copy, designing graphics, and scheduling content aligned with campaigns and seasonal promotions.
Planned, launched, and optimized paid digital advertising campaigns with Google Ads and Meta Ad Manager.
Planned and ran email campaigns in Mailchimp and Constant Contact, including audience segmentation, list hygiene, and performance tracking.
Generated performance reports for clients covering engagement, reach, and campaign effectiveness to inform strategy adjustments.
Wrote ad copy, email campaigns, and marketing content for print, digital, and web, and reviewed copy for consistency and brand alignment.
Delivered full-service branding, signage, wayfinding, and sales marketing for a new home community, from groundbreaking through final sale.
Designed and wrote client presentations, pitch decks, proposals, and informational videos, including decks for client-to-investor and venture capital presentations.
Served as primary client contact, working with business owners and nonprofit clients to understand goals, presenting creative concepts, and refining work based on feedback.
Collaborated with Coachella Valley business owners, publications, paper wholesalers, print shops, and print vendors to develop, execute, and manage marketing and messaging strategies.

Designed brochures, flyers, direct mail, business cards, stationery, trade show banners, booth rollups, branded swag, and sales collateral. Selected and coordinated print vendors and proofed all work before production.
Developed direct mail campaigns in adherence to USPS guidelines.
Directed photography and video production, including lifestyle, product, and location shoots, managing scheduling, vendors, and post-production.
Built and managed client websites on WordPress and WooCommerce, supporting SEO best practices, WCAG accessibility, and brand standards.
Rebuilt Palm Springs Art Museum's email newsletter and produced the YouTube livestream for its 2020 Virtual Art Party fundraiser during the pandemic.
Wrote client proposals with itemized scopes, budgets, and payment milestones, and managed project costs against internal budgets.
Wrote user manuals and documentation for digital platforms built for clients.
Registered trademarks and researched patents through the USPTO.
Developed and maintained brand visual identities and ensured consistency across all branding materials.
Served as one of two IT staffers supporting three physical locations.
Completely modernized server, workstation, telephone, and network infrastructure across 3 locations.
Selected and implemented Veeam for backup and recovery.
Planned and rolled out the PBX to VoIP migration, ran cabling, and crimped RJ45 connectors.
Handled onboarding, offboarding, and help-desk ticketing.
Configured and maintained user access and permissions, network appliances, Cisco Meraki MDM, endpoint protection, network printers, software updates, and startup scripts.
Migrated all Windows servers from bare metal to Hyper-V virtualization.
Planned, staged, and deployed a mass Windows XP to Windows 7 migration.

Consolidated museum communications onto Constant Contact, replacing bulk BCC sends from Outlook that had triggered spam filters, bouncebacks, and domain blacklisting. Configured separated lists and role-based permissions for museum and council staff.
Trained staff across departments on email list management, audience segmentation, and Constant Contact workflows.
Wrote standard operating procedures for digital asset management and internal data workflows.
Maintained The Museum System (TMS) digital asset and collections database, ensuring image and metadata integrity.
Maintained Raiser's Edge CRM for membership and development teams, supporting donor communications and reporting.
Created original graphics and performed live VJ visuals for the Meet the Museum annual fundraiser, supporting event branding and donor engagement.
VJ'd the 2014 Meet the Museum White Party launch fundraiser, designing original graphics and collaborating directly with the musical entertainment.
Supported staff at all levels up to the Executive Director, using reflective and empathic listening to identify problems and recognize opportunities.
Provided technical support to all staff, ensuring reliable access to digital assets, cloud systems, and communications platforms.
